name: 总控子流程 - 超时核对

parameters.query:
SELECT ticket_id, notification_status,
       notification_claimed_at, notification_attempts
FROM tickets
WHERE notification_status = 'processing'
  AND notification_alerted_at IS NULL
  AND (
      notification_claimed_at IS NULL
      OR notification_claimed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE
  )
ORDER BY notification_claimed_at, ticket_id;

parameters.query:
UPDATE tickets
SET notification_alerted_at = NOW()
WHERE ticket_id = $1
  AND notification_status = 'processing'
  AND notification_alerted_at IS NULL
  AND notification_claimed_at <=> $2;
